title: Where did Hayward go?
caption: Hayward left without saying goodbye.

groups.label: San Francisco
groups.detail: Two weather observations, dated 1994-11-27 and 1994-11-29, match one city row.

risks.label: Location repeats
risks.detail:
The city's location appears on both rows.
Count cities from this result and San Francisco counts twice.

groups.label: Hayward
groups.detail:
This weather row has no city to match, so it disappears.
Set "join" to "left" to keep it.

risks.label: Lost without an error
risks.detail: Nothing warns that a reading is missing from the result.

work.label: Keep unmatched readings
work.detail: Use a left join where every reading must show.

work.label: Add Hayward to cities
work.detail: Give the reading a city to match.

work.label: Reject unknown cities
work.detail: A foreign key stops a reading for a city that is not listed.

footnote: Counts come from the tutorial sample, not a live database.
summary: Combining weather with cities keeps San Francisco twice and drops Hayward, because Hayward has no city row.
